title: Quark and Rhubarb Pie
hookLine: Global-inspired quark and rhubarb pie with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: All materials must be in room temperature Dissolve yeast with lukewarm (37C) milk and sugar Add about half of the quantity of flour, mixed with salt Beat the mixture for a short time. Sprinkle with a little flour , cover the bowl with a towel and place in a warm place to rise for ca 1 hour. Incorporate {m53574_1}, {m53574_2}, {m53574_3}, and {m53574_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Add additional flour, cardamom add melted butter. Beat egg and leave ca 1 teaspoon for spreading.Add other beaten egg in to the dough Knead the dough properly, until it separates from the bowl. Sprinkle with a little flour , cover the bowl with a towel and place in a warm place to rise for ca 1 hour until dough is doubled in size. Incorporate {m53574_5}, {m53574_6}, {m53574_7}, {m53574_8}, {m53574_9}, {m53574_10}, {m53574_11}, and {m53574_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll the dough to a square and put in centre quark. Turn edges on to the quark and roll again carefully  to a rectangle. Pour on to the rectangle rhubarb, sugar and cinnamon. leave one edge ca 2 cm empty. Roll and cut in to the equal slices. You should get ca 6-7 rolls. Empty edge turn under the roll as bottom. Put roll in to the butter-spreaded springform pan, as flower. one roll in to the centre and others around. Let enough space to rise. Coat buns with beaten egg before putting into the oven. Bate at 180C 20-30 minutes .

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Decorate with icing sugar. Let Quark and Rhubarb Pie cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
